product.title: Singapore Customized Private Walking Tour With A Licensed Guide

description.text: In Singapore, this private licensed walking outing is customizable from two to eight hours, with a hotel or cruise-terminal meetup when the stay is in the city. The guide shapes the day around published neighbourhood preferences such as the Civic District and Chinatown, plus ticket-booking help for visits the group wants to add. Food and attraction tickets stay separate. Hotels outside the centre use a convenient city meeting point. The format suits visitors who want a tailored walk without a fixed coach script. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Singapore, and the itinerary stays on the Civic District and Chinatown that define this custom window rather than a Mount Faber car day.

highlights: Private licensed walking tour with a custom duration from two to eight hours
Hotel or cruise-terminal meetup in the city
Itinerary shaped around Civic District and Chinatown preferences
Help booking tickets for desired visits
Food and attraction tickets listed separately

start.description: The licensed guide meets at a Singapore city hotel or cruise terminal. Hotels outside the centre use a convenient city-centre meeting point.

end.description: Return to your Singapore meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
